content.title: 1 Restaurant Stock with Promising Prospects and 2 We Turn Down
content.summary: From fast food to fine dining, restaurants play a vital societal role. But it’s not all sunshine and rainbows as they’re notoriously hard to run thanks to perishable ingredients, labor shortages, or volatile consumer spending. Unfortunately, these factors have spelled trouble for the industry as it has shed 8.6% over the past six months. This performance is a far cry from the S&P 500’s 15.6% ascent.
